# perf-class

Advanced performance profiling using perf record and the perf-class tool.

Records CPU cycles with `perf record`, then uses the perf-class Python program
(<https://github.com/tbarbette/perf-class>) to aggregate symbols into categories
using a classification map (dictionary). Outputs `RESULT-PERF-<category>` with
the percentage of time spent in each class.

Usage:
```bash
%import@dut perf-class PERF_TIME=10 PERF_MIN=2
```

Source: [`modules/perf-class.npf`](https://github.com/tbarbette/npf/blob/main/modules/perf-class.npf)

## Variables

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PERF_OPT` | `-g --call-graph dwarf` | Extra options for perf record |
| `PERF_TIME` | `4` | Recording duration in seconds |
| `PERF_EVENT` | `cycles` | Hardware event to record |
| `PERF_MIN` | `1` | Minimum percentage to report |
| `PERF_CLASS_MAP` | `EXPAND($NPF_ROOT_PATH/libs/perf/kernel.map)` | Path to the classification map file |
| `PERF_STACK_MAX` | `8` | Maximum call stack depth |
| `PERF_FREQ` | `1000` | Sampling frequency in Hz |
| `PERF_CLASS_OPT` | *empty* | Extra options for perf-class, e.g. --map path/to/file.map to add your own map |
| `PERF_SCRIPT_OPT` | *empty* | Extra options for perf script |

```{collapse} Late variables

Late variables are evaluated after the variables above.

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PERF_PREFIX` | *empty* | Suffix of the perf data files, to run multiple instances |
```
